subject: Deploy provenance & secrets ownership Q&A
messages:
From: Sam Patel <sam@secureassess.com>
To: rafael_mendes@redwood.com
Cc: compliance@fincloud.com
Date: Sun, 24 May 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Request: deploy provenance + secrets ownership materials

Hi Rafael,

We are doing the SIG/assessor pass for FinCloud and have a short list of artifacts we need to validate deploy provenance and secrets handling for the inference runtime:

- Deploy manifests that show code -> image -> deployment mapping for the past 30 days (timestamped).
- CI/CD pipeline logs that include who triggered builds and merge commits (PR IDs).
- Evidence of gate checks: code review approvals, automated checks (lint/test/scan) tied to PRs.
- Secrets ownership and rotation evidence (KMS key rotation policy, last rotation timestamps, and a sample key rotation report).
- A brief narrative describing the rollback and emergency patch procedure (who authorizes and how artifacts are traced).

Can you confirm you can supply these items by EOD Monday 26-May? If you have any pre-packaged bundles or a Drive folder you typically hand to assessors, that would help speed things up.

Thanks,
Sam
Sam Patel
Lead Assessor, SecureAssess Ltd.

From: rafael_mendes@redwood.com
To: Sam Patel <sam@secureassess.com>
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.com, grace_oconnor@redwood.com
Date: Sun, 24 May 2026 10:08:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: deploy provenance + secrets ownership materials

Sam — thanks for the clear list. We can assemble everything you asked for. Quick plan and owners:

- Deploy manifest (owner: Karthik) — CSV with image hashes, deploy timestamp, cluster/region. Will include PR reference and commit SHA.
- CI/CD logs (owner: Karthik) — filtered pipeline run logs for the date range, redacted tokens, full trigger metadata.
- Code review evidence (owner: Grace) — export of PR approvals, required checks, and scan results for the PRs referenced in manifests.
- Secrets/KMS rotation (owner: Rafael) — rotation policy doc and sample rotation report (no plaintext secrets).
- Rollback/emergency patch narrative (owner: Rafael + Grace) — short one-page procedure and a recent incident example.

I'll coordinate collection and put a Drive folder together. Karthik — can you pull the manifests and CI logs and drop them in the shared folder? Grace — can you export the PR approval snapshots for the referenced PRs?

We should be able to deliver an initial bundle by COB Monday PDT; if anything slips we'll flag it earlier. If you prefer, we can also do a 30-minute sync tomorrow afternoon to walk through the artifacts.

Best,
Rafael Mendes
Director, Security & Compliance Operations
Redwood Inference

From: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
To: rafael_mendes@redwood.com, Sam Patel <sam@secureassess.com>
Cc: grace_oconnor@redwood.com
Date: Sun, 24 May 2026 12:34:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: deploy provenance + secrets ownership materials

On Sun, May 24, 2026 at 10:08 AM Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.com> wrote:
> Karthik — can you pull the manifests and CI logs and drop them in the shared folder?

Got it — I pulled the deploy manifest (deploy_manifest_20260521.csv) and a filtered CI run export (ci_pipeline_log_20260521.txt). Items included:

- deploy_manifest_20260521.csv (fields: deploy_time, region, cluster, image_tag, image_sha, pr_id, committer)
- ci_pipeline_log_20260521.txt (filtered: pipeline_id, trigger_user, commit_sha, status, step_timestamps)

Notes/controls applied before sharing:
- Redacted ephemeral tokens/credentials from logs.
- Kept full commit SHAs and PR IDs for traceability.
- Pipeline logs include the webhook-trigger and manual approvals where present.

Uploading to Drive now (link to come). If the assessor needs the unredacted logs we can arrange a temporary secure share after POA.

—Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Sr. Infrastructure Engineer, Redwood Inference

From: rafael_mendes@redwood.com
To: Sam Patel <sam@secureassess.com>, FinCloud Compliance <compliance@fincloud.com>
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.com, grace_oconnor@redwood.com
Date: Sun, 24 May 2026 15:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: deploy provenance + secrets ownership materials

Sam / FinCloud team — attaching the initial bundle and short notes below. Drive folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3ExampleSharedFolder (shared as Viewer). Doc summary:

Attachments included in the Drive folder (also attached here as stubs):
- deploy_manifest_20260521.csv (mapping image SHA -> PR -> deployment)
- ci_pipeline_log_20260521.txt (filtered pipeline run with trigger metadata)
- kms_rotation_report_20260501-20260521.pdf (rotation timestamps and key IDs)
- sdlc_rollforward_and_rollback_brief.pdf (one-page narrative + recent incident timeline)

Key points:
- Every production deploy has a matching PR and commit SHA recorded in the manifest. The CI pipeline enforces required checks (unit tests, static scan, secret-scan) and requires 1+ approver for merges to main.
- Secrets are stored in a KMS-backed vault. Key rotation policy enforces quarterly rotation; the attached report shows last rotation 2026-05-01 and rotation audit entries. No plaintext secrets were included in these artifacts.
- Emergency patch flow: code is cut from a hotfix branch, gate checks are re-run in a controlled pipeline, and an on-call manager signs off in PagerDuty before the deploy. The brief includes roles and timestamps for the most recent emergency patch.

If you want the pipeline logs with IP/webhook headers or an unredacted KMS audit for forensic purposes, we can provide a secure, time-limited SFTP share after an NDA amendment — let me know the preferred channel.

Would you like a quick walkthrough call tomorrow at 10:00 AM PDT? I can have Karthik and Grace join to answer pipeline and PR gating questions.

Thanks,
Rafael Mendes
Director, Security & Compliance Operations
Redwood Inference
Attachments: [deploy_manifest_20260521.csv (CSV), ci_pipeline_log_20260521.txt (text), kms_rotation_report_20260501-20260521.pdf (pdf)]
